title: Page 77
transc:
130 pm 
SH Beckwith (2)  Wash May 21st 1864 
Harriet Oliver Brown for Chart Orders in accordance with
your letter of yesterday have been sent to Meridan 
tulip Buggy and barn yard have been sent to 
Abbot to make the spurigations & watsons directed in
your whiff of Clotilda wherry wiley Cupid plays smack


930 p. m 
SH Beckwith 2  Wash DC May 21. 1864
hang Rebecca may Nelson Brown ---- If the
Queenlies at Castor Belle Plain & Aquia Creek
are to be transferred to Godwin please let
me know immedy as wedge & Sword are
being sent every hour to the former places
& much delay trifle caused by landing &
reem barking wiley lady ---- ---- ---- ----


RR McCaine  Wash 1030 pm May 22d 1864
Reliance Narrow peach to Mutton Cedar Creek tulip your
mangle to Beach asking for plank pelican just received
Please understand that no weakness can be sent to
your quadroon without the special orders of John &
that all your operations are to be based on
the whisky you now have zebra all available whist
have been ordered elsewhere by Jupiter Zodiac none can
go to you webster Jonah how you like Mackerel
Not sent
